owner_section_changes: Album framing: on an album page the verified account can zoom and move the hero cover or Canvas and publish that framing for every listener (a zoom slider with pinch and drag; a full crop screen is planned for 5.0.0).
The framing is stored with the album's override (frame_scale, frame_x, frame_y) and never changes catalogue data.
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
A signature from the public archive is shown only when its file is named after the exact artist; others keep the plain name.
The archive marks its signatures as unverified; the attribution line under the signature names the source and licence.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
